summary.text: Jay Kilmartin is a Republican state representative from Lexington County who has represented South Carolina House District 85 since November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
The owner of a restaurant and cigar store, Kilmartin serves on the House Education and Public Works Committee.

paragraphs.text: Kilmartin earned a B.A. from the University of South Florida in 1996.
His legislative biography lists him as owner of a restaurant and cigar store.
Kilmartin took office on November 14, 2022, succeeding Chip Huggins.
In the November 3 general election he faces Democrat Steven Asbill Jr.
